title: Ubuntu fixture provisioning and scoped harness posture
summary: Provision a 4 GiB instance (8 GiB recommended), 2 GiB swap and 40 GiB disk. Linux kernel reservations reduce nominal RAM, so the existing physical-page probe requires 3.5 GiB usable RAM (3758096384 bytes). This floor applies only to declared Linux hosts; Windows/WSL retains its separate provisioning contract. The existing verify connection check refuses test_machine_memory_below_minimum before any reset, retaining observed and required total_memory_bytes and asking for a host resize. test_machine_memory_unreadable names a failed RAM probe and asks for SSH/Python probe repair. The usable-total-RAM floor is owned with native_capacity thresholds; swap does not replace physical RAM or the native launch available-memory floor. Yoke manual preparation includes Docker Engine and Compose v2, service/group readiness, actual Linux containers and Compose workloads before capture and after restores; executable presence is insufficient.
